text:
lina_sales: Hey team — POC with FinRegInc is stalling. Customer sees streaming responses cutting off after ~2-3 tokens and then client gets a 504. They use corporate proxy + strict egress.

mika_customer: Here's the error from our app: `FetchError: request to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams failed, reason: socket hang up` and sometimes `504 gateway timeout` in logs.

alex_se: Thanks — can you paste the full request headers + proxy details? Likely a proxy idle/connection close. Also which SDK and versions?

mika_customer: TS SDK v0.9.1, node 18. Proxy is a corporate forward proxy (BlueSeal) with transparent TLS intercept. Header excerpt: `Proxy-Connection: keep-alive`, `Connection: keep-alive`, `TE: trailers`.

sam_engineer: Two quick checks — 1) try disabling HTTP/2 on the proxy path (we've seen h2 proxy translate issues). 2) increase the client-side read/stream timeout. In TS SDK you can set `stream_timeout_ms` in the client config.

lina_sales: Also they asked about pricing if we need dedicated capacity because of sustained streaming. @alex_se can we give a ballpark?

alex_se: Ballpark: if they need reserved GPUs for <50 concurrent streaming sessions, it's usually a monthly commitment. I'll DM exact tiers once we confirm traffic pattern.

sam_engineer: Mika — can you reproduce with curl? Example to test streaming behavior (will show headers and chunking):

``
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4x-redwood","input":"hi","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams
``

mika_customer: Ran curl — it returns SSE chunks briefly then the connection closes. Full curl debug attached.

infra-bot: deploy-hook: observed 429 spikes to the hosted endpoint at 2024-06-02T15:22Z from the customer's IP range — rate-limited fallback triggered.

sam_engineer: Ah 429s earlier could explain falling back to retries which keep connections open. If the proxy enforces per-connection timeouts, retries + long polling = broken stream. Try setting client `max_retries=2` and explicit `request_timeout_ms=45000`.

alex_se: Also check whether their proxy rewrites `Transfer-Encoding` or strips `TE: trailers`. We rely on chunked transfer and `trailers` for some stream termination signals.

mika_customer: I can ask infra to allow `TE: trailers` and extend idle timeout. Is there any SDK code snippet for Python to set timeouts and disable retries?

sam_engineer: Python SDK example:

``
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="...")
resp = c.stream_create(model="gpt-4x-redwood", input="hi", stream=True,
                       request_timeout_ms=60000, max_retries=1)
``

and if using requests behind a proxy, force `Connection: close` to avoid proxy pooling issues.

lina_sales: Security asked if we can provide IP ranges to whitelist for private link — @alex_se pls attach the docs.

alex_se: Will attach IP ranges and cert fingerprint in the ticket. Also note Dedicated option removes public egress if they go private.

mika_customer: Infra extended idle to 70s and allowed `TE: trailers`. After that streaming improved but occasional `502` when we hit spikes.

sam_engineer: If 502/504 persist under spike, recommend Dedicated or a retry-aware edge — or use our `prefix-caching` option to reduce token load. For now set `max_concurrent_streams` per client to 8.

mika_customer: Thanks — testing now. If this stabilizes we'll discuss Dedicated pricing next week.

lina_sales: Great — I'll schedule a call with pricing + security answers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
